name: ModelVariant144_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant144_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (five rings fire one after another from the followed part, then a screen flash, a burst of sparks, an animated grid sprite over the burst centre and a fading ribbon traced through five model parts); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, builds the rings, sparks and grid quads, packs ten texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the burst delay, 1 once when the burst starts, 2 after the spark duration and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-161 and 291 images build it from the same source without the work-size printf and its string (gModelVariant144_szWorkSizeFormat, bound in the North American and Japanese images only), with a 256-line flash, and bind its data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
